mostWorthwhile.text: Adding platelets was most worthwhile because the result clearly showed the vessel leak being limited while the skin gap remained.

leastWorthwhile.text: Reinforcing the plug with clotting proteins felt predictable after the platelet step, although it clarified what fibrin contributes.

surprise.text: I was struck that cleanup and rebuilding can overlap, and that clearing debris still leaves the wound edges separated.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each available component had a clear connection to the wound or the stated goal.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the separated skin edges are rebuilt, since this chapter ended with the repair still unfinished.
